import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.linear_model import Ridge
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error

# Silence progress bars
pd.set_option("display.max_columns", None)
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")


def preprocess_features(train_df, test_df):
    """Preprocess all features - handling datetime, encoding categorical vars"""
    df = pd.concat([train_df.copy(), test_df], axis=0, ignore_index=True)

    # Extract time features from datetime string
    df["pickup_datetime"] = pd.to_datetime(
        df["pickup_datetime"], errors="coerce", utc=True
    )
    df["hour_of_day"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.hour
    df["day_of_week"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.dayofweek
    df["month"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.month
    df["year"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.year

    # Create distance features between pickup and dropoff
    df["distance_x"] = df["dropoff_longitude"] - df["pickup_longitude"]
    df["distance_y"] = df["dropoff_latitude"] - df["pickup_latitude"]
    df["distance_km"] = np.sqrt(df["distance_x"] ** 2 + df["distance_y"] ** 2)

    # Interaction terms
    df["pickup_dropoff_lat_diff"] = df["dropoff_latitude"] - df["pickup_latitude"]
    df["pickup_dropoff_lon_diff"] = df["dropoff_longitude"] - df["pickup_longitude"]

    return df


def main():
    print("Loading data...")

    # Read training data from labels.csv
    labels_data = pd.read_csv("input/labels.csv")

    # Read test data from test.csv
    test_data = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv")

    # Read sample submission template
    sample_sub = pd.read_csv("input/sample_submission.csv")

    print(f"Training samples: {len(labels_data)}")
    print(f"Test samples: {len(test_data)}")

    # Feature engineering on both train and validation data together first
    def get_features(df, is_train=True):
        df_out = df.copy()

        # Time features
        df_out["pickup_datetime"] = pd.to_datetime(
            df_out["pickup_datetime"], errors="coerce", utc=True
        )
        df_out["hour_of_day"] = df_out["pickup_datetime"].dt.hour
        df_out["day_of_week"] = df_out["pickup_datetime"].dt.dayofweek

        # Distance features
        df_out["distance_x"] = df_out["dropoff_longitude"] - df_out["pickup_longitude"]
        df_out["distance_y"] = df_out["dropoff_latitude"] - df_out["pickup_latitude"]
        df_out["geographic_distance"] = np.sqrt(
            df_out["distance_x"] ** 2 + df_out["distance_y"] ** 2
        )

        return df_out

    # Process training data
    train_proc = get_features(labels_data.dropna(subset=["fare_amount"]), is_train=True)

    # Prepare test data
    test_processed = get_features(test_data, is_train=False)

    # Define feature columns
    feature_cols = [
        "hour_of_day",
        "day_of_week",
        "pickup_longitude",
        "pickup_latitude",
        "dropoff_longitude",
        "dropoff_latitude",
        "passenger_count",
        "geographic_distance",
        "pickup_datetime_month",
        "pickup_datetime_hour",
        "pickup_datetime_year",
        "pickup_datetime_week",
    ]

    # Reconstruct feature columns properly
    X_train = train_proc[feature_cols].values.astype(np.float64)
    y_train = train_proc["fare_amount"].values

    # Scale features
    scaler = StandardScaler()
    X_train_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X_train)

    # Create train/validation split for unbiased hold-out validation
    X_train_full, X_val, y_train_full, y_val = train_test_split(
        X_train_scaled, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=None
    )

    print(f"Training set size: {len(y_train_full)}")
    print(f"Validation set size: {len(y_val)}")

    # Train model only on training data (never on validation)
    model = Ridge(alpha=1.0)
    model.fit(X_train_full, y_train_full)

    # Predict on validation set
    val_pred = model.predict(X_val)

    # Compute RMSE on hold-out validation set (this is what gets reported)
    rmse_val = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_val, val_pred))
    print(f"\nHold-out Validation RMSE: {rmse_val:.4f}")

    # Handle potential NaN in validation
    if np.isnan(rmse_val):
        print("Warning: NaN in validation metrics, checking for outliers...")
        rmse_val = float("inf")

    # Now predict on actual test set (unlabeled data)
    test_X = test_processed[feature_cols].values.astype(np.float64)
    test_X_scaled = scaler.transform(test_X)

    test_predictions = model.predict(test_X_scaled)

    print(f"Generated {len(test_predictions)} test predictions")

    # Prepare submission file
    os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

    # Build submission dataframe matching sample format
    submission_df = sample_sub.copy()
    submission_df["fare_amount"] = np.round(test_predictions, 2).values

    # Save submission file at required path
    submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
    print(
        f"\nSubmission saved to: ./submission/submission.csv ({len(submission_df)} rows)"
    )
    print(
        "\nFinal Evaluation Metric (RMSE on Hold-Out Validation Set):",
        f"{rmse_val:.4f}",
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
